expected.reason: Line 234-236: when projectType=="plugin" the group is an OR of project_type:plugin AND project_type:mod in the SAME bracket, not two separate AND groups. The header comment explains why: Geyser/Floodgate and similar cross-platform projects are typed "mod" on Modrinth even though they behave like plugins, so a pure project_type:plugin search would silently exclude them.

notes: A plugin-server catalog search that used only project_type:plugin would never surface Geyser/Floodgate on Modrinth -- P8.10's port must reproduce this OR group exactly for plugin-kind catalog search, not just filter by a single project_type.
